run.environment: Pre-commit worktree; local controllable Playwright with real Astro, Vite, Bun/Elysia, and a unique disposable PostgreSQL cluster
run.data_mode: Synthetic intake and campaign fixtures in a new suite-owned PostgreSQL cluster
limitations: No Maestri Portal was connected; authorized local controllable Playwright was used.
Astro Dev Toolbar emitted one audit Failed to fetch message during location.replace; it was classified separately from product errors.
This successful pre-commit worktree evidence must be repeated after the final commit at the PR SHA.

journeys.name: Apply migrations 0000 through 0021 to empty PostgreSQL
evidence: Migration process completed before synthetic fixture insertion in a new suite-owned cluster.

journeys.name: Resolve an active campaign link to an explicitly allowlisted localhost destination using replace history
evidence: Real API returned 200 for the active synthetic row.
Browser reached the exact allowlisted destination and Back returned directly to /privacy, skipping the campaign URL.
Campaign entry emitted no analytics, product console errors, failed responses, or non-navigation request failures.

journeys.name: Render indistinguishable permanent UX for inactive, expired, and invalid campaign links
evidence: Direct API checks returned 404 for inactive and expired synthetic rows.
Inactive, expired, and invalid states had equal eyebrow, heading, message, home action, focus behavior, and mobile layout.

journeys.name: Recover a temporary campaign resolution failure through visible retry
evidence: Owned database outage produced the public 503 temporary UX with visible retry.
After recovery, visible retry returned 200 and navigated to the allowlisted destination.

journeys.name: Activate privacy-safe analytics only after applicable consent
evidence: Zero analytics requests before consent and after essential-only selection.
Analytics initialized and cta_clicked emitted only after explicit opt-in.
Recorded property keys excluded lead and PII fields without logging bodies or values.

journeys.name: Submit the real public form and retain one delivery plus one lead after reload
evidence: HTTP 201 and safe aggregate deliveries=1, leads=1 persisted after reload without payload or PII output.

journeys.name: Separate liveness from readiness during database outage and recover
evidence: Health remained 200, readiness became 503, and readiness recovered to 200 after the same disposable cluster resumed.

observations: Landing page and consent controls are visible, readable, and unobstructed.
Consent banner is absent and the landing remains unobstructed after essential-only selection.

screenshots.checkpoint: Post-consent landing page after banner removal
observations: Landing page is sharp and unobstructed; consent banner is absent after opt-in.
Privacy content is readable and the legal journey is unobstructed.
Mobile menu fits the viewport and exposes its navigation without clipping.
Correct destination is fully rendered without consent or development overlays.

screenshots.checkpoint: Inactive, expired, and invalid permanent states
observations: All three screenshots are visually equivalent, readable, focused, and free of clipping.
Expired state is visually indistinguishable from the inactive and invalid permanent states.
Invalid state is visually indistinguishable from the inactive and expired permanent states.

screenshots.checkpoint: Temporary failure with retry and safe home action
observations: Temporary state is clearly differentiated and both recovery actions fit the mobile viewport.
The visible form is sharp, readable, and unobstructed before submission.
Success content remains sharp, stable, and unobstructed.
Mobile success remains readable without clipping or obstruction.
Reloaded mobile form remains readable without clipping or obstruction.

access_checks.vector: Campaign destination allowlist and analytics consent boundary
access_checks.evidence: Only the explicitly allowlisted localhost destination resolved; campaign entry emitted no analytics and post-consent property keys excluded lead/PII fields.

findings.title: Empty PostgreSQL migration chain created a duplicate FK
evidence: Migrations 0000-0021 completed on a new empty PostgreSQL cluster.

findings.title: Campaign entry had no integrated resolve endpoint
evidence: Active link returned 200 and replaced browser history with the exact allowlisted destination.

findings.title: Composed app mapped inactive campaign links to 500 instead of 404
evidence: Direct API and browser checks returned code-only 404 for inactive and expired links; permanent UX equality passed.

findings.title: Astro development audit logs a failed fetch during location replacement
evidence: The exact dev-toolbar message and net::ERR_ABORTED navigation cancellations were classified separately; product errors remained empty.
